projectPillars.title: 100% Free & Open Access
projectPillars.desc: No locked tiers, paywalls, or predatory financial product advertisements. BudgetBasics is purely dedicated to student education.

projectPillars.title: Zero Bank Linking Required
projectPillars.desc: Your privacy is paramount. We never request bank logins, credit card credentials, or personal identity documents. All calculations stay in your browser.

projectPillars.title: Tailored For Student Life
projectPillars.desc: Built from real student scenarios: roommate grocery splits, campus transit passes, used textbooks, and modest monthly allowances.

projectPillars.title: Habit-Building Simplicity
projectPillars.desc: We replace intimidating 200-row spreadsheets with the simple 50/30/20 formula and quick daily expense tracking that takes seconds.

initialTestimonials.name: Maya Patel
initialTestimonials.comment: The Needs vs Wants game opened my eyes! I didn't realize how much late-night takeout orders were quietly bleeding my monthly campus stipend.

initialTestimonials.name: Liam O'Connor
initialTestimonials.comment: Having quick presets like $450 Pocket Allowance made testing immediate on my phone. Super clean and fast without annoying sign-up popups.

initialTestimonials.name: Elena Rostova
initialTestimonials.comment: Finally a tool that doesn't demand my bank credentials or bomb me with credit card ads. BudgetBasics is exactly what college students need.
